sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 199 x 125 x 64 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Apogee Symphony Desktop User Guide v1.30a (Apogee-owned CDN copy), opened 2026-11-12 (pdftotext): 8.0 in W x 4.75 in D x 1.25 in to 2.5 in H (203.2 x 120.7 x 31.8 to 63.5 mm), 1.85 lb. This differs from the dealer size of the plan row (199 x 125 x 64 mm): the plan row is marked conflict (estimate), so the device is beta-modelled with the plan size. Connectors per the guide: rear XLR inputs 1-2 and 1/4 in inputs 1-2, instrument input on the front, main outputs 1-2 (panel not stated: drawn on the rear), headphone 1 (1/4 in, front) and 2 (3.5 mm, rear), optical in and out (the number of outputs is not stated), USB-C, USB host (type not named: not modelled), locking DC barrel input from the external supply (no signal type: not modelled, so no mains inlet and no power control). The guide panel tour is a picture, so every position is a guess. The sloped top and the touch screen are only picture. The Thomann page of the plan is delisted (no spec text). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
